lower_thirds.text: Avalanche Fuji testnet · no real-world value

vo.tone: Hushed, close to the mic, slow. Like telling a secret at night.
vo.cue: Rain ambience; celesta motif starts under you.

vo.tone: Still hushed, a little ominous. Slow down on 'knot together'.
vo.cue: Tangle close-up. Finish before the BOOM at 0:05.0.

vo.text: One café still keeps its lantern lit... and its cats intend to keep it that way.
vo.cue: Starts just after the title slam settles; ends as Clover appears.

vo.text: Choose your path: battles, strange encounters, treasure... and a boss at the end.
vo.tone: Brisk and inviting. Lift on 'treasure', small pause, then drop on 'boss'.
vo.cue: Route map on screen; drums enter at 0:20.

vo.text: Your cats fight on their own. You decide when they unleash their ultimates.
vo.tone: Confident, a grin in the voice.
vo.cue: Hit 'ultimates' as the cursor taps the portrait (0:32.5).

vo.text: Every victory can drop new gear. Equip it, forge it stronger, and push into the next chapter.
vo.tone: Upbeat, building. Three clear beats: equip / forge / push.
vo.cue: Glockenspiel sparkle on the drop at 0:40.

vo.text: Here, power is earned by playing. Never bought.
vo.tone: Calm, sincere, slower. Full stop before 'Never bought'.
vo.cue: Music drops to piano; this is the honest moment.

vo.text: But when a piece of gear matters to you, seal it on Avalanche. Now it's truly yours.
vo.tone: Calm, clear, a little proud on 'truly yours'.

vo.text: Keep it, or trade it on the Relic Market.
Seals burn YARN, a fixed-supply token... and every sale burns part of its fee.
vo.tone: Precise, confident, not salesy. Steady pace.
vo.cue: Starts on the market card and carries into the supply counter. No hype here.

vo.tone: Darker, lower, slower. Let it hang.
vo.cue: Over the Yarn Giant reveal; music turns to B minor.

vo.tone: Whisper-intense, close mic. The only sound in the silence.
vo.cue: Total silence bar (1:37.5). End before 1:39.4; the hit lands at 1:40.0.

vo.text: Lantern Cat Café. A cosy card RPG... where the light you protect is yours to keep.
vo.tone: Warm, proud, slower. Small pause after 'card RPG'. Smile on 'yours to keep'.
vo.emphasis: Lantern Cat Café / yours to keep
vo.cue: Back in the warm cafe; lockup appears at 1:50.
CTA card. Finish before the final chord fades.
